name: conversation-list
summary: A long list of conversations that builds only the rows in view: title, time, preview and an unread dot, with the open one marked.

properties.name: label
properties.description: What the list is, such as "Conversations".

properties.name: selectedId
properties.description: The id of the open conversation; its row is marked current.

properties.name: density
properties.description: comfortable shows a preview line under the title; compact shows the title and time only.

properties.name: empty
properties.description: What to show in place of the list when there are no conversations. Defaults to "Nothing here yet".

properties.name: moreLabel
properties.description: Names each row's more button: the label, then the row's title.

properties.name: unreadLabel
properties.description: The word read out for a row with new messages.

slots.name: rows
slots.description: The conversations, one per line as "id: title | time | preview | unread" (preview and the word unread are optional). A line "# Heading" starts a section whose header opens and closes it; its title names its list.

events.name: select
events.description: A row was chosen; carries its id.

events.name: sectionOpenChange
events.description: A section header opened or closed it; carries the section id and whether it is open.

states.name: rest
states.description: The rows in view. The open row has an accent fill and the platform's current marker; a row with new messages has a dot before the title and the title in bold.

states.name: pressed
states.description: A row held down: the accent fill a step stronger.

states.name: focused
states.description: A row with keyboard focus: the platform's focus ring.

accessibility.name: The list by its label; each row by its title, then the unread label when it has new messages, then its time and preview; the open row is current; each row has a more button named by moreLabel and the title.
accessibility.keyboard: The list is one tab stop and the stop lands on the open row; the arrow keys move between rows, Home and End go to the first and last, Enter or Space opens one.
accessibility.web: A list that builds only the rows in view once it has more than 20 rows (fewer are all built); the open row has aria-current.
accessibility.apple: A List with the open row selected; each row one element with the title, unread state and preview in its label.
accessibility.windows: A ListView, virtualised by its ItemsStackPanel; each row a ControlType.ListItem with the SelectionItem pattern, the open one selected; the full count is available to UI Automation.
accessibility.android: A LazyColumn with CollectionInfo for the full count; each row one merged node with the SelectionItem state for the open one, named by its title, unread state and time.

slots.rows: a: Ari | 9:41 | Lunch at noon? | unread; b: Sam | Mon | Notes from Monday

cases.person: Two rows: Ari's with a dot and a bold title, and Sam's marked as the open one.

children.name: Sam, Mon, Notes from Monday, current

cases.person: No rows: the words "No conversations yet".

deviations: Web takes items and sections as arrays and reports onSelect(id); the spec's rows slot is that data.

windows.type: Ouro.UI.Windows.OuroConversationList, a templated WinUI Control; not yet built
